status: Research proposal; live-run integration, calibration, packing, and submission approval remain required

execution.physical_qubits: Fresh calibration and topology-qualified joint placement must determine this value
execution.atlas_construction: 12 edges per box kite times eight distinct phases; each setting samples one edge from each of seven box kites concurrently
execution.walk_settings: Depths 0 through 4 on both cores, followed by exchanging class assignments between the two physical tiles; co-schedule those ten paired settings inside the 96-setting atlas
execution.control_boundary: Isolated edge references cover one representative edge per box kite, not every edge. Readout preparations characterize endpoint bias, not a full correlated readout channel. Randomize and counterbalance settings with a recorded seed to limit order and workload confounding.

time_model.formula: job overhead + sum_settings shots * (scheduled circuit duration + repetition delay)
time_model.qualification: About 35 seconds under explicit illustrative assumptions; live compilation, scheduler duration, and service overhead remain unqualified. Extra width can change schedule and crosstalk. Historical timing comes from results/live/2026-10-11T152922.787095Z/ADJUDICATION.md.

mathematical_program.walk: U=M W, M=Rx(pi/2) tensor four, W is the four-bit core of the dimension-32 associator phase
mathematical_program.factored_qubit: Both full five-bit oracles have form diag(D,-D), equivalent to an independent Z on bit 4 multiplying D on bits 0 through 3; the protocol omits that independent factor
mathematical_program.primary_observable: Return probability at depth 4, compared between classes after exchanging physical tiles
mathematical_program.secondary_observable: Depth-2 collision probabilities 11/32 and 5/32; depth-3 return probabilities 1/4 and 0
mathematical_program.collision_estimator: sum_x count_x*(count_x-1)/(N*(N-1)); uncertainty must account for dependent collision pairs
mathematical_program.nulls: Depth 1 is uniform and identical for both classes. A fully dephased model stays uniform after each mixer; this is a modeled reference unless an actual dephasing protocol is included.
mathematical_program.period_boundary: Exact Gaussian-integer checks establish these finite ideal periods for the specified protocol. Early hardware prefixes cannot verify the long periods, literature novelty, or computational advantage.
mathematical_program.box_kites: Seven assessor octahedra with 42 unsigned vertices, 84 edges, and 336 ordered signed zero-product witnesses
mathematical_program.fringe: P(ancilla=0)=(1-r*cos(phi))/2 for an edge sign r; only the appropriate real-phase endpoint is a real zero product
mathematical_program.frustration: All 56 triangular faces have edge-sign product -1; separate edge experiments cannot be reinterpreted as one globally dark assignment

rendering.associator_motion: Fixed Hamming-distance geometry, node area from measured probabilities, theoretical exact frames kept explicitly labeled
rendering.box_kites: Fixed assessor geometry, edge darkness from measured ancilla-0 probability with uncertainty, continuous curves labeled fits
rendering.timing_art: Actual retained scheduler event times with physical-qubit labels and separate initialization, gates, readout, and finalization
rendering.residuals: Hardware-minus-model differences shown separately; preserve imperfections instead of painting over them
rendering.phase_color_boundary: Computational-basis counts alone do not measure complex amplitudes or phase
rendering.playback_boundary: Frames are separately prepared circuit prefixes from one job; display interpolation is artistic playback, not continuous observation of one state
